fusions.name: Feint Jab
fusions.desc: Flicks the fork at the first enemy it meets, dealing 4 damage with a 25% chance to turn it against its allies for 3 seconds. Its reach is 40% longer.

fusions.name: Slipped Between
fusions.desc: Finds the gap in its guard and thrusts through, dealing 30 damage that ignores armour and leaving the target 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Straw Man
fusions.desc: Props up a pitchfork-wielding scarecrow for 12 seconds that jabs an enemy within 5 tiles every 2 seconds for 3 damage, with a 30% chance to leave it [Marked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Light Fingers
fusions.desc: Each time you afflict something, your next strike gains 20% critical hit chance. Once every 8 seconds.
